_comment: Descriptions for the static browse pages (scripts/lib/static_site.py) where the web UI, the data/*.tsv catalogs, a model/dataset card or the ZIM's own metadata have none. zim: Kiwix project -> sentence ({topic} = the ZIM's topic words, {lang} = language name, {flavour} = ', full with images' / ', text only' / ', introductions only'). tools/names: folder name -> sentence. Anything not listed still gets a generated sentence.

zim.wikipedia: Wikipedia{topic_in} in {lang}{flavour}: the free encyclopedia, readable offline in Kiwix.
zim.wiktionary: Wiktionary in {lang}{flavour}: the free dictionary with definitions, pronunciations, etymologies and translations.
zim.wikibooks: Wikibooks in {lang}{flavour}: open textbooks, manuals and cookbooks anyone can edit.
zim.wikiversity: Wikiversity in {lang}{flavour}: free courses, lessons and learning materials.
zim.wikivoyage: Wikivoyage in {lang}{flavour}: the free travel guide with places, routes and practical tips.
zim.wikiquote: Wikiquote in {lang}{flavour}: a collection of sourced quotations from people, books and films.
zim.wikisource: Wikisource in {lang}{flavour}: public-domain and freely licensed source texts, books and documents.
zim.wikinews: Wikinews in {lang}{flavour}: free-content news articles written by volunteers.
zim.wikispecies: Wikispecies{flavour}: a directory of species and taxonomy across the tree of life.
zim.vikidia: Vikidia in {lang}{flavour}: an encyclopedia written for readers aged 8 to 13.
zim.devdocs: DevDocs reference for {topic}: the official API documentation, searchable offline.
zim.freecodecamp: freeCodeCamp {topic} curriculum in {lang}: interactive coding lessons and exercises.
zim.ted: TED talks{topic_on} ({lang}): short expert talks on science, technology, design and ideas, with video.
zim.gutenberg: Project Gutenberg library in {lang}{topic_paren}: tens of thousands of free public-domain books.
zim.phet: PhET interactive simulations in {lang}: hands-on physics, chemistry, maths and biology experiments.
zim.khanacademy: Khan Academy in {lang}: video lessons and exercises from maths and science to economics.
zim.maps: Offline maps{topic_paren}: browse streets and places without an internet connection.
zim.avanti: Avanti {topic} ({lang}): video lessons for school students.
zim.cest-pas-sorcier: C'est pas sorcier ({lang}): the French science-explainer TV series, episode by episode.
zim.shamela.ws: Al-Maktaba al-Shamela ({lang}){topic_paren}: a large library of classical Arabic books.
zim.madrasa: Madrasa ({lang}){topic_paren}: Arabic-language school lessons and exercises.
zim.coreyms: Corey Schafer's programming tutorials{topic_on}: videos on Python, Git, Linux and more.
zim.ifixit: iFixit repair guides in {lang}{topic_paren}: step-by-step instructions to fix devices and gear.
zim.youscribe: YouScribe ({lang}){topic_paren}: books and documents from the YouScribe library.
zim.ekopedia: Ekopedia ({lang}): a practical encyclopedia of alternative living, gardening and self-sufficiency.
zim.mdwiki: WikiProjectMed medical encyclopedia ({lang}){flavour}: health and medicine articles for offline clinics.
zim.openstreetmap-wiki: The OpenStreetMap wiki ({lang}): how the map works, tagging guides and tools.
zim.zimgit: A curated Kiwix collection about {topic} ({lang}): practical guides gathered into one offline archive.
zim.stackexchange: {site} ({lang}): questions and answers from the Stack Exchange community{topic_on}.
zim.survivorlibrary.com: The Survivor Library ({lang}): historical books on farming, crafts, medicine and how things were made before modern industry.
zim.rationalwiki: RationalWiki ({lang}){flavour}: articles on science, pseudoscience and critical thinking.
zim.appropedia: Appropedia ({lang}): a wiki of appropriate technology, sustainability and DIY solutions.
zim.wikem: WikEM ({lang}): the emergency-medicine reference used by clinicians.
zim.fas-military-medicine: Military medicine field manuals ({lang}): emergency and trauma care references.

names.maddy: maddy: a single-binary mail server (SMTP + IMAP) used by Val Ark's offline LAN mail service.
names.alps: alps: a lightweight webmail client in front of the maddy mail server for Val Ark's LAN mail.
names.node: Node.js LTS runtime, portable: lets Val Ark run its community services (forum, chat) with its own Node, offline.
names.piper: Piper: a fast, local neural text-to-speech engine with many voices, running on CPU.
names.whisper.cpp: whisper.cpp: a C/C++ port of OpenAI Whisper for fast local speech recognition on CPU or GPU.
names.llama.cpp: llama.cpp: runs GGUF language and vision models locally on CPU or GPU.
names.redis: Redis: an in-memory key-value database used by Val Ark's community services.
names.thelounge: The Lounge: a self-hosted web IRC client used by Val Ark's offline LAN chat.
names.ngircd: ngIRCd: a small IRC server for Val Ark's offline LAN chat.
names.nodebb: NodeBB: a modern forum platform used by Val Ark's offline LAN message boards.
names.microbin: MicroBin: a small self-hosted pastebin and file-sharing service for the LAN.
